pr.title: gh-111178: remove redundant casts for functions with correct signatures
pr.body:
This is a cleanup PR but it's easier to hunt non-covered possible UBSans

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-111178 -->
* Issue: gh-111178
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->
